name: get_tle
description: Fetch the Two-Line Element (TLE) set for a specific satellite by its NORAD catalog ID. Returns the satellite name, epoch date, and both TLE lines.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog number for the satellite (e.g. 25544 for the ISS, 20580 for Hubble Space Telescope).

name: search_satellites
description: Search for satellites by name or keyword. Returns matching satellites with their NORAD IDs and TLE data.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for (e.g. "ISS", "Starlink", "GPS").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

name: list_recent
description: List the newest satellites in the NORAD catalog, highest catalog number first. NORAD ids are assigned in roughly launch order, so this approximates most-recently-launched. Note this orders by catalog entry, not by TLE epoch — the upstream offers no epoch-date sort.

limit.description: Number of satellites to return. Defaults to 10.
